english.title: Attempt to open tram door otherwise than at tramstop when tram has come to a halt on the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to open a tram door on the Croydon Tramlink system at **(..SPECIFY THE TRAMSTOP OR LOCATION..) other than at a tramstop when the tram had come to a halt
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 11(4), 30 and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: Byelaw 11(4) provides a defense to this offence:- 11(4) Save where necessary in order to facilitate an emergency evacuation, open a tram door other than at a tramstop when the tram has come to a halt.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant attempted to open a tram door on the Croydon Tramlink system at **(..SPECIFY TRAMSTOP OR LOCATION..) other than at a tramstop when the tram had come to a halt.
